_help: Game catalogue. Every entry with demo: true is SAMPLE content and is labelled 'Demo' on the site. Delete demo entries when real titles are signed. For a real game set demo: false and add an authorised playUrl or storeLinks. Fields: slug, title, genre (one of the categories), platforms, ageRating, origin, stage, published, featured, added (YYYY-MM-DD), short, description, cover (image path or empty for generated art), playUrl, storeLinks.
